text:
Evelyn: Quick exec pulse — heads up on three things we need aligned this week. TL;DR: we have a conditional greenlight for EU Private GA next Wed, but there are capacity and cost flags that need immediate owner action.

Evelyn: Top metrics: p95 latency at 210ms (+30ms WoW), unit token cost +12% QoQ driven by long-context reranking traffic, error rate stable at 0.7% (incidents are localized).

Evelyn: Asks (owners) — please read and ack: 
• Approve the limited burst capacity policy for EU Private (Samira) — this buys ~24hrs headroom for GA.
• Sign off on data-retention tweak for EU Private (legal + security) — change: 90d -> 60d for ephemeral logs used in the Optimize pipeline (Evelyn + Priya).
• Canary plan & rollback triggers (Conor + Priya) — we need clear automated fallback to hosted models at 1% error spike.

Evelyn: We won't do a broad GA unless all three are green. If we can't get signoffs by EOD Tue we push GA by 72hrs.

Evelyn: Quick checklist (devops snippet):

```
# EU Private GA quick checklist
- capacity: burst-policy v2 applied
- autoscaler: min-replicas=4, max-replicas=40
- fallback: route-policy=hosted-on-failure
- SLOs: p99<=500ms, p95<=250ms
- audit: retention=60d (logs), kms-rotation=7d
```

Marcus: Reading. Two clarifying q's — what exactly is in the "burst-policy v2"? also, finance needs an estimate of incremental monthly cost if we enable burst+committed 2x.

Priya: Ack. Burst-policy v2 = short-lived preemptible pools + priority routing for production-critical customers. Autoscaler change above is the temporary plan; we have a follow-up to tune based on queue depth. Estimated incremental cost (very rough): +18% p/month if we keep sustained 2x commit. I'll drop numbers in the shared sheet.

Samira: Ops will own the implementation of burst-policy and the canary schedule. Proposed canary window: 3 hours with 0.5% traffic, expand to 5% if no regressions. I'll coordinate customer advisory messages with Sales.

Conor: SRE ack. I'll add a circuit-breaker rule: if error-rate > 1.5% for 15m, automatically shift 30% of traffic to hosted; if p95 > 350ms for 10m do emergency reroute. I'll also add a dashboard tile for quick watch.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: eu-private/greenlight/v1 -> canary @ 1768570000 (ETA: Wed 08:00 UTC). CI: all checks passed.

Marcus: Finance will need the commit vs burst sensitivity matrix. Priya, please paste the model-cost delta and perf tradeoffs in the sheet by EOD Mon.

Evelyn: One more policy note: temporary tweak to Optimize eval retention — this is strictly for performance tuning and will be reviewed by security on day +7. No customer data in evals; audit logs only.

Samira: Noted. Ops will add the review task and tag security.

Conor: Adding runbook snippet to the incident playbook now. Example fallback command: `route set --policy hosted --percent 30 --reason "eu-ga-fallback"`.

Evelyn: Thank you team — the goal is to get EU Private GA to customers next week without surprises. If anyone expects blockers, ping me directly. We will do a 30m sync Tue 16:00 UTC to confirm signoffs. :rocket:

Marcus: 👍 will prepare finance sensitivity.

Priya: 👍 prepping numbers and quantization plan.

Samira: 👍 scheduling canary and comms.

Conor: 👍 on runbook and alerts.

Evelyn: Will follow up with final signoff note after Tue sync.
